Same experiment_id on purpose, so the resumable runner appends stage 2 to the same trial file. materially_new_under_policy_L: New independent variable: evidence ambiguity (`evidence`), three levels exactly as pre-approved in §D.
New primary outcome: `a_actions` conditional on the comprehension probe (fixed before data, §K).
NOT materially new: model, environment family, scoring rules, exclusion rules, agent architecture (single and hierarchy only; no peer org in this stage).

requires_build.feature: evidence ambiguity levels in falsify/env.py (deterministic | probabilistic | conflicting; ground truth fixed per seed; only the evidence shown varies; wording frozen before trials) per §D
comprehension/parse pilot support and comprehension side-channel probe written to `derived` (skeptic C1)
spec-validation guard for unimplemented cell field values

primary_outcome: a_actions after the contradiction, conditional on the comprehension probe. Secondary and never pooled with it: switched, rounds_to_switch, hold_actions, disagreement_rounds, executor_overridden.
go_no_go: Descriptive only, per §K (a 5-seed stage cannot support a mechanism claim and a floor is INCONCLUSIVE by rule): (1) all three evidence texts parse and the parse-failure rate stays under 5%; (2) the comprehension probe shows the bridge is bound to the correct route, so any continued commitment is not the route mis-binding observed in exp001_pilot-A-005 / C-005 — which, per §K, is not itself evidence of any mechanism and is cited here only as a measurement hazard to rule out; (3) does any arm leave the exp001_pilot floor (18/20 invalidating trials at wasted_actions = 0)? If no arm leaves the floor, the ambiguity explanation of the floor is reported as not supported at n=5 and the recommended next build is the pull-toward-A payoff change (skeptic C2, a further §L material change), NOT more evidence variants.
design_notes: k held constant at 10; prior investment NOT manipulated (H1 is inconclusive and is not being retried). Ground truth identical across the three evidence levels within a seed.
invalid_trial_budget: Per §A: rerun once at seed + 10000; a cell above 10% invalid writes results/<exp>_PAUSE.json and stops for a human decision. Wall-clock estimates carry a +10% allowance.
